name: lispslop-feature-matrix
description: Exhaustive specification matrix for LispSlop on fixed-3^19

features.semantics: Factorial function via table for x <= 11
Bitwise / logical AND (1 if both > 0 else 0)
Bitwise / logical OR (0 if both 0 else 1)
Equality comparison returning 1 if equal else 0
Inequality comparison returning 1 if unequal else 0
Define global binding in symbol table

positive_cases.stdin: (defmacro unless (c a b) (list 'if c b a))

features.semantics: Print value representation and return it
Generate sequence of integers 0 to n-1
Apply function to each element of list
Check if any element satisfies predicate
Check if all elements satisfy predicate
Sort numeric list in ascending order
Apply function with duplicated argument f(x,x)
Reset memory heap and global bindings
Display word count of used memory
Export heap memory image to Base64 ASCII
Import heap memory image from Base64 ASCII
Infix square bracket sugar [a f b] -> (f a b)
Fork curly brace sugar {f g} -> (fork f g)
Unrecognised dot command prints Eh? and halts
